cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to check what a delay costs. Here's the timetable: three buses missed while you had my keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've counted the minutes. Now count the cold dinner on this receipt. I'll put it beside the timetable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy you another. Can we clear these papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly there. I taught you to acknowledge a mistake before paying for it. Say you're sorry and I'll clear the table; keep your money.
